reader: AI assistant (Claude; eight reader instances, each given one contiguous slice of hardmath_extraction_cases.json: case id and call text only); blind to workflow, item, gold and harness reading at reading time; no human check

status_codes.answer: text states a final answer (verbatim in 'answer')
status_codes.none: text states no single final answer
status_codes.truncated: text cut off before stating a final answer

cut_off_flag: answer status but text cut off after an explicit final-answer statement (sensitivity variant counts it as truncated)

batches.rule: cases file 'read' list in file order, batch b = items [b*n//8:(b+1)*n//8]

pre_freeze_checks.text_consistency: answer readings whose text (whitespace removed) does not contain the answer, and none/truncated readings whose text contains '\boxed': 12 cases listed, each re-read from the text, no reading changed

spot_check.method: re-read from the text by the auditing session (Claude), blind as above
